profile.Name: Infinite Wingwang
profile.Personality: Grandiose and theatrical, he sees himself as a rare prize. He haggles wildly over his price and dances like a madman when a deal is struck.
profile.Backstory: Sword for hire. A sword for hire who waits in a bar in Mongrel and offers his services to anyone who will pay his price.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Always calls himself 'Infinite Wingwang' in the third person. Shouts dramatic challenges like 'Dare you?!' and uses odd phrases such as 'my feathered friend'.
